title: Grandfather's radio plays on wedding day
summary: Michael Shermer tells of Grandfather's radio plays on wedding day, about 2014 at Shermer's house, Los Angeles area, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: coming from the desk. So I open the drawer and there's the radio on perfectly tuned to a station playing beautiful romantic music

plain: A researcher named Michael Shermer, known for doubting such claims, says that on his wedding day in 2014, at his house near Los Angeles, he heard music coming from a desk. He says he opened the drawer and found a grandfather's old radio switched on, perfectly tuned to a station playing beautiful romantic music, a story he tied to his wife Jennifer and wrote about in his column for the magazine Scientific American. He tells it because, if taken at face value, it would look like a sign from beyond ordinary explanation.
